summary: First full test pass of thoraHELP. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (auth, signals CRUD, respond/resolve, messages, websocket auth+ack/pong, voice multipart upload, 30s radius escalation 100m->200m). Frontend: landing page, signup, admin login, dashboard with SOS dialog, signal creation+chat, profile save with toast, and header dropdown logout all work. All required data-testids present.

issues: Toast 'SOS sent' overlays the header-profile-trigger area briefly; could intermittently block clicks just after creation (test had to wait/redo dropdown open). Consider moving toast to bottom on logged-in screens.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~650 lines and mixes auth, signals, ws, storage, and background tasks — fine for MVP but should be split into routers/modules as it grows.

CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True when CORS_ORIGINS='*'. Browsers reject wildcard with credentials; current implementation works because regex reflects origin, but document or restrict for prod.
Voice upload depends on Emergent object storage; returns 503 if storage init fails — graceful, but UI should surface that to the user.
Escalation loop has fixed 5s tick + 30s threshold; first escalation can take up to ~35s (verified in test with 38s sleep). Acceptable but could log first-escalation latency.
Geolocation gating: SOS dialog still opens without coords; backend create-signal then fails. Consider disabling sos-confirm-btn until lat/lng are available.
test_credentials: Admin admin@thorahelp.app / Admin@12345 verified working. New users created via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Random TEST_*@thorahelp.app users created via register endpoint for each session; one resolved signal sig_* and one general signal for voice upload remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. The escalation test sleeps 38s — run with `pytest -k 'not Escalation'` for fast iteration. WebSocket tests use the `websockets` package (installed). Geolocation must be granted via context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + context.set_geolocation. After admin profile-save toast appears, wait ~1s before clicking header-profile-trigger to avoid the toast intercepting the dropdown menu items.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Logout via dropdown initially failed once because the success toast briefly overlaid the dropdown menu; a small wait after navigation resolved it on retry.
